package.name: Conjur3
package.description: Live parametric CAD harness. Runs an in-process RPC server so an external MCP client (Claude Code) can drive the running FreeCAD GUI in real time — every edit updates the 3D viewport on the next recompute.

workbench.description: Starts the Conjur3 RPC server on :9875 and exposes 30+ curated tool handlers (sketches, pad/pocket/revolve, fillets, booleans, patterns, variable sets, exports) for external LLM-driven modeling.
